result.instructions: C2MD generates EU AI Act / GDPR / NIST / ISO 42001 governance artifacts for AI agents. Discovery and `assess_agent_risk` are free and need no key. Everything else needs a getvda.ai suite key — call `get_test_key` to find out how to get one free. Generated artifacts are DRAFTS requiring compliance-officer sign-off; C2MD does not deliver legal compliance.
